description: This script manages and logs the status of various security features and configurations related to advanced security in a device, including telemetry logging, parental controls, privacy protections, and feature enablement checks.

methods.name: check_status
methods.description: Main function that checks various security and configuration statuses and logs telemetry data accordingly.

methods.name: print_telemetry_log
methods.description: Helper function that appends a telemetry string to a log file if it is not already present.
